exposure: placenta previa overlying a previous cesarean section scar
outcome: Prevalence of placenta accreta spectrum disorders
cohort: Women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum overlying a cesarean section scar at a Portuguese tertiary center over a 10-year period
finding: The prevalence of placenta accreta spectrum disorders overlying a cesarean section scar was 0.6/1000, and early antenatal diagnosis allowed for programmed multidisciplinary management, resulting in no maternal or neonatal deaths.
mod_finding: All cases in the study involved cesarean section, so mode of delivery was not compared.
